name: Zhejiang Zhongxin Environmental Protection Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Zhongxin Environmental Protection Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of paper and paperboard container in China and internationally. The company offers food packaging products, such as bowls, cups, plates, trays, clamshells, cutlery, and takeaway boxes. It also provides cushioning trays for mobile phones, headphones, and smartwatches; inner trays for cosmetic gift boxes; customized cushioning structures for health products; and integrated shockproof and moisture-proof packaging for tobacco and alcohol. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Jinhua, China.
